rows.dimensions: 2000x1300 (2 px per scene unit; scene old-watch 1000x650, grid 50)
rows.source: Written by the visual-01 map-art task; full record: assets/maps/sample/PROVENANCE.map.json (merged here by the scaffold writer, values copied from it on 2026-09-30)

master.c2pa: present in the master (claim generator OpenAI Media Service API; software agent ChatGPT; digital source type trainedAlgorithmicMedia); the WebP derivative does not carry it, so this record is the reference

rows.licence: Owner-generated original art (project-owned); generated for the owner; likely not copyrightable (IT L.132/2025 art.25). OpenAI assigns the output to the owner; no third-party pixels, fonts, textures or logos; no text in the image.
rows.generator: Codex built-in image_gen (owner ChatGPT plan) — codex-cli 0.155.0-alpha.16.4, `codex exec --sandbox read-only`, feature image_generation, login: ChatGPT (OPENAI_API_KEY unset; no paid API)
rows.edits: Uniform scale 2000/1536 of the 3:2 output, then drop the 16.67 px bands of outside ground that the 3:2 guide added above and below (magick -distort AffineProjection with viewport 2000x1300+0+0); geometry not shifted; Gaussian blur 0x0.7 at 2000x1300 to remove the generator's fine texture noise and meet the byte budget; cwebp -q 80 -m 6 -metadata none
rows.use: Sample content: scene ground of 'old-watch' («Il cortile dell'osservatorio», campaign «Le lanterne di Bruma») while a round-1 direction is active. Walls, doors and measurements stay live data drawn by the app. Shown through the sprite pattern dir-sample-scene when index.mjs finds the file (data-sample-map="on").
